method: Official object-page metadata, public permanent Harvard NRS image addresses, current Brooklyn Museum image service, exact image captions and explicit originalMediaUri fields on official exhibition pages. knownLimits: Some British Museum pages still return a challenge page. MFA Boston and several other museum image endpoints still reject direct access. Exhibition posters, detail images and ambiguous scene matches were excluded.
